newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finance minister submits resignation - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Thai finance minister submits resignation - ministry.

text.p: Thailand's Finance Minister Bodi Chunnananda has submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa, a senior finance ministry official said on Monday.
"Bodi asked me to announce that today he has submitted his resignation to the prime minister. It will take effect tomorrow," the ministry's permanent secretary Chatumongkol Sonakul told reporters.

Chatumongkol also said Bodi did not state the reasons for his unexpected resignation. The unelected Bodi was appointed on May 27 by Banharn to replace former finance minister Surakiart Sathirathai who was sacked by the premier.
Chatumongkol added that the minister had assigned key ministerial duties and important tasks to him.

The two important tasks ahead were deciding on the issue of new banking licences to three consortia which have received preliminary approval for permission to start banks and the upgrade of seven foreign bank offshore representative offices to full bank branches.
Chatumongkol said final approval on these two issues, however, would be the prerogative of the any new incoming minister.
